Location: North of England, covering the North West, Yorkshire and the North East

Please note: This role requires the successful candidate to be based in the North of England, with occasional travel to customers across the territory. Due to the location and travel requirements, applications from candidates based outside the area will not be progressed.

Bizimply is a people management solution that empowers multisite hospitality, retail, and healthcare companies in the UK and Ireland to save time and money. Our platform streamlines operations, enhances team management and drives efficiency, enabling our clients to focus on delivering exceptional customer experiences.

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Sales Development/Account Executive, who really understands selling SaaS products to the hospitality and retail industries. You will combine your industry knowledge and selling skills to initiate and develop long-lasting relationships with prospective customers and manage your own sales pipeline. This role will focus on outbound strategies, leveraging your own network, attending events, building partnerships, and collaborating with our marketing, product and sales colleagues to meet and exceed sales targets.

If working for Bizimply interests you and you believe you can make a big impact, please get in touch! As many of our roles have specific geographic coverage requirements, the area to cover for this specific role is the UK North East.
data.key_responsibilities:
• Become a product expert, clearly and confidently understanding the problems faced by our customers and clearly demonstrating the benefits and value Bizimply adds.
  • Demo the product (online and in-person) and confidently present Bizimply.
  • Managing your pipeline through various stages, forecasting new business.
  • Own and achieve quarterly and annual sales quotas aligned with company objectives.
  • Carry out detailed and analytical discovery to find out the root cause of problems facing our customers.
  • Proactively identify and prospect new customers through your own network, outbound initiatives and strategic partnerships.
  • Manage feature requests and collaborate with our product team to continue improving our best-in-class tools.

data.description:
An engineering role for a developer who wants to own test automation: you'll build the framework, wire it into CI and make quality part of how the team ships. Web first, then mobile.

About the role

Bizimply builds workforce management software used by hospitality and retail businesses to schedule, pay and manage their frontline teams. We're looking for an engineer who treats test code as production code and wants to own how we test.


You'll start with our web application: building and scaling an end-to-end and API automation suite that runs on every pull request. Once that's solid, you'll extend the same approach to our iOS and Android apps. You'll work inside the engineering team, reading source code, debugging failures down to the root cause, and shaping testability from design onwards.
data.key_responsibilities:
Web (first 6 months)
  • Design, build and own our web end-to-end automation framework (Cypress or Playwright), with clean architecture, stable selectors and low flake rates.
  • Write API tests in code that cover contracts, error handling and edge cases, and run in the pipeline alongside UI tests.
  • Integrate all suites into CI/CD (e.g. GitHub Actions) so every pull request gets fast, trustworthy feedback.
  • Validate data flows and migrations with SQL, checking integrity, transactional state and schema changes.

Mobile (next)
  • Extend automation to our native/hybrid iOS and Android apps using Appium, Maestro, Detox or similar.
  • Choose the mobile tooling and decide how it fits into the existing framework and pipeline.

Across the team
  • Join sprint planning, design reviews and PR reviews to push for testability early.
  • Use AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) to speed up test authoring, generate test data and debug flaky tests.
  • Triage and track defects in Jira, and write clear, reproducible bug reports.
  • Coach developers to write and maintain tests for their own code.


What success looks like

  • 3 months: Critical web user journeys are automated and run on every PR, and the team trusts the results.
  • 6 months: PR feedback in under [15] minutes, flake rate below [2%], and API coverage on core services.
  • 12 months: Mobile smoke and regression suites run in CI, and developers write tests as part of normal delivery.
data.skills_knowledge_expertise:
What you'll bring
  • 5+ years in software engineering or test automation, with at least 2 years writing automation code as your main job. A background as a developer or a CS/software engineering degree is strongly preferred.
  • Web automation: Hands-on experience building and maintaining an E2E framework in Cypress or Playwright (JavaScript/TypeScript), not only adding tests to someone else's.
  • API test automation: Testing APIs in code (Cypress, Playwright, REST Assured or similar) or Postman/Newman running in CI.
  • CI/CD: You've set up and maintained automated test runs in a pipeline (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or Bitrise).
  • SQL: Confident writing your own queries to validate backend data and migrations.
  • Code-level debugging: Comfortable reading application source code to find the cause of a failure.
  • AI tooling: You already use AI coding tools in your daily work and can tell when their output is wrong.

Nice to have

  • Mobile automation on iOS and Android (Appium, Maestro, Detox or similar). This is a strong plus because mobile is our next phase.
  • Experience testing AI or LLM-powered features, such as evaluation suites and handling non-deterministic outputs.
  • Datadog or similar APM tools for log analysis, synthetic tests and checking service health after deployment.
  • Performance and load testing with k6, Locust or JMeter.
data.title: Senior SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test)
